messages:
maria: Heads-up: scheduled maintenance in us-west-2 (AZs a,c,e) — kernel + NIC firmware upgrades. Window: Tue Mar 2 02:00-05:00 PT. Rolling, rack-by-rack. Expect per-rack 5-12m restarts. Will run a canary loadtest before wide roll.

alex: Quick q — what's the expected p99 delta and which services will restart?

maria: p50 should be unchanged. p99 for inference RPC may spike ~150-300ms for ~3-8m during a rack drain. Serving runtime pods will be restarted; control plane mostly unaffected except local edge routers and KVS on that rack.

jordan: Plan: run canary at 01:30 PT (30m before maintenance) at ~5% traffic + synthetic traffic. Abort conditions: errors > 1% OR p99 > 300ms sustained for 5m.

jordan: Canary command (local dev tool):

```
# run synthetic chat load against canary pool
./bin/loadgen --target http://canary-infer.usw2.internal/generate --rps 80 --duration 600 --payload-file tests/payloads/chat.json
```

deploy-bot: maintenance_event scheduled: us-west-2 AZs 02:00-05:00 PT. Details: https://internal/maint/1907654321 :calendar:

nick: I'm oncall 01:15-06:00 PT and will be primary. Please @nick if abort triggers. Can we wire a rollback trigger to PD if canary fails?

anya: KV cache note: draining racks will evict local KV shards. Recommend increasing pre-warm replicas and running cache warm after each rack. Command to prewarm a keyset: `rd-cache-warm --region usw2 --keyset core_prompts --replicas 3`

maria: Rollback plan: vendor firmware rollback is available but slow; prefer abort and re-route traffic to fallback quantized model pool `fallback-quant` if canary fails. Health checks: `/health` + per-route latency metrics.

alex: I'll run a short synthetic chat at 01:35 PT targeting canary nodes to validate payload shapes and latency. Quick load command: `hey -c 50 -q 100 http://canary-infer.usw2.internal/generate`

jordan: +1. I'll update SLO dashboard and set temporary alert thresholds (p99 alert -> 2x baseline) for the window.

nick: Posting to #incidents if we hit abort criteria. Also creating a PD escalation for automatic notify if errors >1%.

maria: TL;DR: Canary 01:30 PT, maintenance 02:00-05:00 PT (rolling). Oncall @nick. Abort if >1% errors OR p99 >300ms for 5m. Runbook + docs: https://internal/maint/1907654321/docs. Ping if you need rack assignments or to opt-out specific clusters. :wave:
